name: Compare 2 Plan
description: Add prompt-mode versus summary-mode comparison project support so comparison flows can use Covevidence-style human and LLM overall screening decisions with explicit source-project persistence, validation, and UI controls.

userStories.title: Add summary-mode fields to comparison project persistence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison projects to persist summary-mode configuration and copied prompt criteria metadata so overall human and LLM decisions can be derived without relying on inferred source projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `human_judgment_mode` to `app.comparison_project` with `prompt` and `summary` values and default existing rows to prompt mode.
Add nullable `summary_source_project_id` to `app.comparison_project` referencing `app.project`.
Add `criteria_disposition`, `criteria_section_key`, and `criteria_section_label` to `app.comparison_project_prompt`.
Update comparison-project schema typing so the new persisted fields are available to server and client code without inventing parallel types.
Existing prompt-mode comparison projects continue to load as prompt mode with no behavior change.
`bun run db:mig` passes
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes

userStories.title: Expose summary-mode comparison contracts and source metadata
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison-project API contracts and source-project payloads to expose summary-mode fields so create, edit, and read flows can make mode-aware decisions consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend comparison-project create, create-from-project, fetch, and update contracts to include `humanJudgmentMode` and `summarySourceProjectId`.
Update `fetchComparisonProjectSources` payloads to expose whether a source project is summary-capable and enough metadata to drive summary-mode UI decisions.
Update comparison metadata and edit-form responses to return the saved mode and summary source project information.
Treat missing or `NULL` human-judgment mode values as `prompt` so legacy data remains compatible.
`bun test <targeted comparison test files>` passes
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes

userStories.title: Persist and validate summary-mode create and edit flows
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison-project create and edit routes to validate summary-mode requirements and copy source prompt criteria metadata so saved comparisons remain stable even if the source project later changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Summary mode requires `compareWithHumans = true`, a valid `summarySourceProjectId`, and selected prompts that exist on the chosen summary source project.
Manual create and edit copy prompt criteria metadata from the selected summary source project into `app.comparison_project_prompt` for the saved prompt set.
Create-from-project saves `humanJudgmentMode = 'summary'` and `summarySourceProjectId = sourceProject.id` when the chosen source project is summary-capable and the summary toggle is enabled.
Invalid summary-mode requests fail with clear errors instead of silently falling back to prompt mode.
Prompt-mode create and edit behavior remain unchanged for existing comparison flows.
`bun test <targeted comparison test files>` passes
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes

userStories.title: Derive summary-mode comparison scope and judgment cells
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the comparison backend to build summary-aware scope, human rows, and derived LLM summary answers so comparison results can switch cleanly between prompt mode and overall-decision mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `ComparisonProjectScope` with `humanJudgmentMode`, `summarySourceProjectId`, and selected prompt criteria metadata.
In summary mode, load human answers from `app.judgment_human_summary` filtered by `summarySourceProjectId` and use the latest non-empty answer per article.
In summary mode, derive one strict LLM summary answer per model and content variant using `getNormalizedSummaryAnswer` and `deriveStrictSummaryAnswer` over the latest prompt answers.
Emit synthetic summary columns and cells in summary mode while preserving existing prompt-level columns and cells in prompt mode.
Sparse-row, fully-answered, and model-difference filtering operate against the shown summary columns in summary mode without changing prompt-mode behavior.
`bun test src/server/utils/judgmentAnswers.test.ts` passes
`bun test <targeted comparison test files>` passes
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes

userStories.title: Add summary-mode controls to comparison creation flows
userStories.description: As a user, I want comparison creation forms to let me choose summary mode with the right source-project constraints so I can build Covevidence-style overall-decision comparisons without manual database setup.
acceptanceCriteria: `Create New Comparison` adds a summary toggle and a required summary-capable source-project picker when the toggle is enabled.
Manual summary mode constrains prompt selections to prompts available on the selected summary source project with the required summary criteria metadata.
`Compare Project` only enables the summary toggle for summary-capable source projects and submits the new fields when selected.
Form validation and loading states follow the existing comparison-form conventions and explain why summary mode is unavailable or invalid.
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes
Verify in browser that a manual summary comparison can be created from a summary-capable source project

userStories.title: Show summary-mode editing and comparison results
userStories.description: As a user, I want summary-mode comparison projects to be editable and rendered with overall human and LLM decision columns so I can inspect agreement without prompt-by-prompt human columns.
acceptanceCriteria: The comparison edit page shows the saved human-judgment mode, shows the selected summary source project in summary mode, and only allows valid mode switches.
The comparison results metadata cards show the human comparison mode and summary source project when present.
The comparison table renders overall-decision columns only in summary mode with clear labels such as `Overall decision` or `Include this study?`.
Row highlighting and visible filters continue to work in summary mode while prompt-mode rendering remains unchanged.
`bun run lint` passes
`bun run build` passes
`bun run desktop:build` passes
Verify in browser that a summary comparison can be edited and that summary-mode results render correctly

userStories.title: Lock prompt-mode and summary-mode behavior with regressions
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want targeted regression coverage for comparison-project summary mode so future changes cannot break source scoping, derived summary answers, filters, or legacy prompt-mode behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add targeted coverage for prompt-mode compatibility, summary-mode validation failures, summary-source scoping, and derived LLM summary answers.
Add coverage proving model-difference and fully-answered filtering behave correctly for synthetic summary columns.
Coverage includes create, create-from-project, edit, and judgment-page paths where summary mode changes behavior.

The final verification covers creating a summary comparison from a Covevidence project, creating a manual summary comparison from a summary-capable source project, editing a summary comparison, and confirming prompt mode remains unchanged.
